qualification_scope: Given a precharacterized finite event bracket, qualify transactional PONDED_HEAD -> EVENT_AT_SURFACE_ZERO -> DRY_FLUX composition for the selected B01 and O14 fixtures. Event detection/bracket discovery is outside this gate.

candidate_algorithm.initial_admission: Confirm S0>0 and qtop(S0,h1_0)>q_supply, so the committed state starts in ponded/head mode and is physically depleting. This is a face evaluation only, not a soil nonlinear trajectory.
candidate_algorithm.trajectory_1_event_corrector: Solve [h1,h2,h3,t_event] from the original committed state with S_event=0, three conservative soil equations, and -S0-t_event*(q_supply-qtop_event)=0. t_event is bounded by the frozen characterization bracket.
candidate_algorithm.trajectory_2_dry_remainder: From the uncommitted event state, solve the remaining interval with qtop=q_supply and S=0. Require dry complementarity at the accepted remainder state.

reference_algorithm: Same two-trajectory event/remainder composition using independent full-accuracy internal faces and endpoint-aware high-accuracy 5 cm surface-face references.

transaction_contract.event_corrector: Worker scratch only; never publish event state independently.
transaction_contract.dry_remainder: Starts physically from the event state but remains part of the same outer trial.
transaction_contract.synthetic_post_event_reject: Must restore the original pre-event committed state bitwise, not retain the event state.
transaction_contract.commit: Publish only final dry state after event, remainder, conservation and comparison gates pass.

architecture_checks.4_compact_persistent_state: Only ordinary soil heads and the existing surface-storage scalar are persistent. Event time/state are scratch.
architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: Event and remainder nonlinear vectors belong to worker scratch.
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Outer checkpoint survives both subtrajectories until final commit; rejected event/remainder restores original state.
architecture_checks.8_warm_start: Event state may initialize the remainder, but the event solve itself originates physically from the committed ponded state.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Event is an offset inside [t0,t1], not a day boundary.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Segment and whole-interval balances must independently close; no water is clipped when surface storage reaches zero.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Composition uses soil-step and surface-face contracts, not HeadCalc arrays.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: S=0 and complementarity define the physical switch; nonlinear tolerances are numerical policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Exactly two nonlinear trajectories are required once the event bracket is available.
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: Event bracket/time, mode sequence, nfev, balances and rollback status are outputs.

hard_nonclaims: No automatic runtime event detection or bracket discovery is qualified.
No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head state is qualified.
No runoff, evaporation, snow, irrigation or macropore bypass.
No response tangent through event switching.
No production runtime, MultiSWAP, groundwater or MODFLOW admission.
